name: PDGMS Ontology
description: Master schema defining all valid key categories for DeepThought proposal extraction. Every KV pair extracted from proposals must derive from this ontology.

client.description: Client organization identity and point of contact

client.name.description: Legal name of the client organization

client.challenge.description: Primary business challenge or pain point

client.poc_name.description: Primary point of contact person's name

client.business_model.description: Current business model (e.g., referral-based, direct sales)

client.problem.cause.description: Root cause of the client's challenge

client.problem.symptom.description: Visible symptom of the client's challenge

client.role_to_hire.description: Specific role the client is seeking to hire

client.role_requirements.description: Requirements for the role to hire

client.is_first_non_founder_hire.description: True if the role is the first non-founder hire

client.failed_hire_cost_inr.description: Estimated cost in INR of a wrong/failed hire

client.failed_hire_timeframe_months.description: Months over which a failed-hire cost is incurred

engagement.description: Engagement model, scope type, temporal boundaries, and operational structure

engagement.acceptance_trigger.description: Event that formally begins the engagement

engagement.efficiency_model.description: How the engagement consolidates traditional roles

engagement.delivery_timeline_days.description: Days from approval to full delivery

engagement.layers.l{n}.label.description: Operational layer label (e.g., Strategy, Management, Execution)

engagement.layers.l{n}.responsibility.description: What the layer is responsible for

engagement.layers.l{n}.traditional_owner.description: Who traditionally owns this layer (client side)

engagement.layers.l{n}.dt_owner.description: Who owns this layer in the DT model

scope.description: What is and is not included in the engagement

scope.boundaries.description: Engagement boundaries: DT vs client work split

scope.sow.s{n}.area.description: Statement-of-work area name (e.g., Account Management, Operations)

scope.sow.s{n}.responsibility.description: What is owned in this SOW area

phases.description: Multi-phase breakdown of work, cost, and timeline

phases.p{n}.cost_inr.description: Cost allocated to this phase in INR

phases.p{n}.deliverables.description: List of deliverables for this phase

commercials.description: Pricing, payment terms, milestones, and financial terms

commercials.payment.m{n}.trigger.description: Payment trigger for milestone N (e.g., m1, m2)

commercials.payment.m{n}.pct.description: Percentage of total payable at this milestone

commercials.payment.m{n}.amount_inr.description: Fixed amount in INR for this milestone

commercials.payment_days.description: Days allowed for payment from invoice date

commercials.upfront_fee_rationale.description: Why an upfront fee is required

commercials.candidate_approval_required.description: Whether client must approve the candidate before deployment

commercials.advance_adjustment.description: How an advance is adjusted later (e.g., against last invoice)

team.description: Resource allocation, roles, hours, and costs

team.r{n}.role.description: Role title (e.g., r1, r2 for Senior Consultant, etc.)

team.r{n}.hours.description: Total hours allocated to this role

team.r{n}.total_cost_inr.description: Total cost for this role (hours × rate)

team.r{n}.allocation_percent.description: Allocation percentage if part-time/shared across projects

methodology.description: Frameworks, approaches, tools, and processes used

methodology.frameworks.description: Frameworks or methodologies used (RCA, CSA, First Principles, etc.)

methodology.data_sources.description: Data sources to be analyzed or used

methodology.tools.description: Tools and platforms used in execution

methodology.qc_rules.description: Quality control rules or validation criteria

methodology.framework.f{n}.name.description: Name of an individual methodology framework

methodology.framework.f{n}.applies_to.description: Layer or step the framework applies to

methodology.rca.purpose.description: Purpose of the Root Cause Analysis step

methodology.csa.purpose.description: Purpose of the Current State Analysis step

methodology.icp.data_points.description: Data points used to define the Ideal Customer Profile

methodology.channel_selection.principle.description: Guiding principle for selecting outreach channels

assumptions.description: What DeepThought assumes the client will provide or already have

assumptions.client_inputs.description: Client information or context to be provided

assumptions.client_resources.description: Resources client must provide (tools, access, people)

assumptions.preconditions.description: Pre-conditions that must exist for success

dependencies.description: What client must deliver and by when

dependencies.d{n}.item.description: Item or deliverable client must provide
dependencies.d{n}.item.example: Sales performance data for past 6 months

responsibilities.description: RACI matrix: who is responsible for what

responsibilities.client.supervision.example: Daily supervision of Fellow's work; final sign-off on output

kpis.k{n}.name.description: KPI name or metric (e.g., k1, k2)

kpis.k{n}.definition.description: How the KPI is measured or defined
kpis.k{n}.definition.example: Client satisfaction score from feedback surveys

kpis.k{n}.measurement_window.description: How often or over what period measured

clauses.non_poaching.duration_months.description: Duration of non-poaching restriction after engagement ends (in months)

clauses.non_poaching.scope.example: DT Fellow cannot be hired as employee or contractor

clauses.ip_ownership.description: Who owns IP created during engagement

clauses.confidentiality_scope.description: What information is covered by confidentiality
clauses.confidentiality_scope.example: All systems and workflows built by the Fellow

guarantees.description: Service guarantees, replacement policies, and commitments

guarantees.replacement_trigger.example: Performance or cultural misfit per client's formal request

guarantees.replacement_timeline.example: Upon formal request and sign-off by client

exit.notice_period_days.description: Notice period required for disengagement in days

exit.data_handover.description: What happens to deliverables at exit

deliverables.description: Detailed breakdown of deliverable contents and properties

deliverables.handover.path{n}.name.description: Name of a Plug-and-Play handover path (e.g., Field Sales)

deliverables.handover.path{n}.includes.description: Items included in this handover path

deliverables.handover.path{n}.target_rol.description: Role this handover path is designed for

deliverables.hiring_kit.jd_focus.description: JD focus of the hiring kit

deliverables.hiring_kit.interview_questi.description: Number of interview questions in the rubric

deliverables.hiring_kit.interview_tests_.description: What the interview is designed to test

deliverables.lead_gen.vetting_purpose.description: Purpose of the lead vetting filter

deliverables.comms.cold_opening_duration.description: Length of cold opening script in seconds

deliverables.comms.cold_opening_format.description: Format of cold opening (phone, in-person, etc.)

deliverables.dashboard.format.description: Format of the management dashboard (Excel, CRM, etc.)

deliverables.dashboard.weekly_review_dur.description: Length of weekly review meeting in minutes

deliverables.selection.interview_framewo.description: What the structured interview framework provides

deliverables.candidate_ld.module{n}.description: Pre-interview L&D module description (e.g., CNC basics)

plans.description: Tiered pricing plans (e.g., Free / Fresher / Experienced)

plans.p{n}.tier.description: Tier name of the plan (free, fresher, experienced, etc.)

plans.p{n}.best_for.description: Who this plan is best for

plans.p{n}.payment.on_joining_inr.description: Payment due on candidate joining in INR

offers.description: Conditional or complimentary offers (e.g., Blueprint Service)

offers.o{n}.value_inr.description: Stated value of the offer in INR

training.description: Per-week or per-day training plans for hires/Fellows

training.week{n}.description: Training plan content for week N

training.day{n}.description: Training plan content for day N

training.month{n}.description: Training plan content for month N

ld.description: DT's Learning & Development framework competencies and behaviors

ld.competency.c{n}.layer.description: Operational layer the competency maps to

ld.competency.c{n}.tools.description: Tools used to develop or apply the competency

ld.training_burden.description: How training burden is allocated under the L&D model

outcomes.description: Expected outcomes / success indicators of the engagement

next_steps.s{n}.duration_minutes.description: Duration of step N in minutes

notes: Every KV pair extracted from a proposal must use a key path from this ontology.
Arrays are stored as JSONB arrays in the proposal_kv_store table.
Numeric values (costs, percentages, hours) must be extracted as numbers, not strings.
Dates must be ISO 8601 strings (YYYY-MM-DD) or null if not specified.
Enum fields must only contain values from the allowed enum list.
When a proposal doesn't specify a value, the KV pair should not be created (don't store null).
Complex nested data (e.g., multiple phases, team members, payment milestones) uses indexed notation: phases.p1, phases.p2, team.r1, team.r2, etc.
